verdict.rationale: Mesh lets you generate API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, configure their permissions, and set an optional expiry date. Endpoint references name specific required permissions (e.g. "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which suggests scoping can be fine-grained enough for least-privilege agent keys. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of credential permission scopes and how they map to the API, any agent-specific credential or identity guidance, credential rotation/revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
